name: mixed_languages_afrikaans_english
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle a message mixing English and Afrikaans and still provide a helpful response about melamine boards

messages.text: Hi, ek soek white melamine 16mm, can you help?

expected_behaviors.description: Response should acknowledge the melamine board request

notes: User mixes Afrikaans ('ek soek' = 'I am looking for') with English. The AI should understand the intent and respond helpfully about 16mm white melamine boards, possibly in the same language mix or in English.
